description: Master repeatedly framed the MCP token-refresh risk as 'the unattended 6am run' and told David 'tomorrow's 6am ingest on the new default'. There is no scheduled 6am ingest: plaud-ingest runs only when David runs the boot workflow, which he triggers manually. David corrected: 'It's not on a timer, I run the boot workflow.'
correction: The refresh risk is 'the first boot that happens after token expiry', not a fixed early-morning unattended run. Because David triggers the boot, a refresh failure lands while he is at the keyboard, and the failure is immediate to fix. The 5-day byte-identical gate also accrues per boot run, not per calendar day, so gate days without a boot do not accrue.
systemic_fix: Do not assume scheduled-task cadence for workflows that are actually controller-triggered. When describing when a risk fires, derive the trigger from how the workflow is invoked (boot-time spawn vs cron/scheduled task) before naming a time.
